beliefs.title: Bank Nifty is the index to buy in a flat market
beliefs.plain: In a flat / slow market, Nifty Bank beats the Nifty 50 over the next month.

beliefs.title: Bank Nifty is a no-brainer (beats the Nifty in any market)
beliefs.plain: On any day, Nifty Bank beats the Nifty 50 over the next month.

beliefs.title: Bank Nifty leads the Nifty
beliefs.plain: When Nifty Bank beat the Nifty by 1%+ over the last 5 sessions, the Nifty rises over the next 5 (and falls after Bank Nifty lags by 1%+).

beliefs.title: Exchange, broker and AMC stocks win in a slow market
beliefs.plain: In a flat market, an equal basket of BSE, MCX, CDSL, ANGELONE, CAMS, KFINTECH and peers beats the Nifty over the next month after 0.25% charges.
beliefs.note: Most of these stocks listed between 2017 and 2022, so the in-sample period is short.

beliefs.title: After a sharp fall the Nifty bounces
beliefs.plain: After the Nifty falls 3%+ in 5 sessions, its next 5 sessions are better than usual.

beliefs.title: After a sharp rise the Nifty gives some back
beliefs.plain: After the Nifty rises 3%+ in 5 sessions, its next 5 sessions are worse than usual.

beliefs.title: Last month's worst sector bounces (mean reversion)
beliefs.plain: Buying the sector index that did worst last month beats the Nifty over the next month.

beliefs.title: The strongest sector keeps winning (momentum)
beliefs.plain: Buying the sector index that did best over the last 6 months beats the Nifty over the next month.

beliefs.title: A sector that lagged for a year is cheap and catches up
beliefs.plain: A sector index that trailed the Nifty by 15%+ over 12 months beats it over the next 6 months (the shape of the 'IT is cheap' view).
beliefs.note: Price-based proxy: index P/E history is not in the data yet.

beliefs.plain: Each month buy the 20 Nifty 500 stocks with the best 12-month return per unit of risk among the calmer half; they beat the Nifty over the next month after 0.25% charges.

ideas.title: Sector vs Nifty spread snaps back
ideas.plain: When a sector index is 2+ standard deviations cheap (or rich) against the Nifty over 60 days, buy it and sell beta x Nifty futures (or the reverse). Exit when the gap closes or after 21 sessions.
ideas.hedge: Market-neutral: the Nifty leg cancels the market move.
ideas.sizing: Needs two futures legs (a Nifty lot is roughly Rs 15 lakh of exposure), so it is above a Rs 5 lakh account; paper-trade it or use the option version later.

ideas.title: Long Bank Nifty, short Nifty in a slow market
ideas.plain: In a flat market, buy Bank Nifty and sell beta x Nifty for one month (the hedged form of 'Bank Nifty is the safest index in a slow market').
ideas.sizing: Two futures legs, above a Rs 5 lakh account.

ideas.title: Sell Nifty's 1-month range, wings bought (iron condor)
ideas.plain: Each month sell the Nifty call and put one VIX standard deviation away and buy the ones two away. Earns when the Nifty stays inside the range VIX prices; the loss is capped by the wings.
ideas.hedge: Defined risk: the bought wings cap the loss at the strike gap minus the credit.
ideas.sizing: Max loss per lot = max loss points x lot size, far above the Rs 5,000 per-trade limit; it only fits that limit as a much narrower spread.
ideas.note: Priced with Black-Scholes off India VIX with a 15% haircut for skew and fills (no real option history yet); per-trade figures are return on the capped loss.

ideas.title: Narrow Nifty iron condor that fits the per-trade limit
ideas.plain: Same monthly 1-sigma short call and put, but the bought wings sit only 100 points further out, so the worst case is small enough for the per-trade limit.
ideas.hedge: Defined risk: worst case = 100 points minus the credit, per lot.
ideas.sizing: Worst case about Rs 4,810 a lot (65 units), so 1 lot(s) within the Rs 5,000 limit.
ideas.note: Lot size 65 assumed (check NSE's current Nifty lot). Same Black-Scholes pricing and 15% haircut; narrow wings are priced least reliably this way, so treat the back-test as rough.
